_comment: Sn-beta glucose C2->C1 intramolecular hydride transfer (Mushrif, Varghese, Krishnamurthy, PCCP 2015, DOI 10.1039/C4CP05063K). Keys starting with '_' are comments. Every null below MUST be filled from the authoritative structures before any stage will run; nothing here is inferred from a real Sn-beta geometry. Atom indices are ZERO-BASED (ASE order of input/reactant.xyz).

system.label: Sn-beta / glucose C2->C1 hydride transfer
system._charge_comment: Total charge and spin multiplicity (2S+1) of the full model system. Must be set explicitly: MACE-OMOL/POLAR silently assume 0 / 1 when absent. Not stated in any source read so far (Oct 2026 audit); a neutral closed-shell Sn(OSiH3)3 cluster is plausible but UNCONFIRMED — take it from Tian's files.
system._require_comment: Si: the Sn model is drawn as a SiH3-capped cluster, Sn(-O-SiH3)3, in Ali 2025 thesis Fig. 4.1 (captioned as adapted from the paper's Fig. 1); the thesis text describes three framework O. Remove Si here if Tian's files use a different termination.

structures._provenance_comment: Record where the files came from (Tian / original CPMD trajectory frame, cell, any cluster cut) in input/README.md.

_atom_map_comment: C1 = aldehyde carbon (hydride acceptor); C2 = carbon losing the hydride; H_transfer = migrating H on C2 in the reactant (H2 in the paper's Fig. 1c); H_C1 = the H already on C1 (H1 in Fig. 1c); Sn = active-site Sn; O1 = C1 oxygen; O2 = C2 oxygen (deprotonated, bonded to Sn in the reactant); O_water = O of the water formed at the Sn site from Sn-OH + the C2-OH proton, which stays coordinated to Sn.
_fixed_atoms_comment: Indices (or atom_map names) held fixed in optimization/NEB/Sella. The reference model is a SiH3-capped cluster, so freezing the cap atoms is likely needed — but which atoms (and whether) is Tian's call; leave empty until confirmed.

sn_site.source: Ali 2025 MSc thesis, Fig. 4.1 (captioned as adapted from Mushrif et al. 2015 Fig. 1). '6 O, octahedral' is stated only for the pre-deprotonation complex (Fig. 4.1a caption); for the hydride-step reactant/product, 3 O-SiH3 + O1 + O2 + H2O is OUR READING of the drawing (Fig. 4.1b/c). The water 'remains coupled to Sn' is stated (Sec. 4.2).
sn_site._comment: Diagnostic WARNINGS only (validate_structure._check_sn_site), never acceptance criteria; counted within validation.sn_shell_A.

CV1.status: ATOMS CONFIRMED (secondary): CN of C1 with H1 and H2 (thesis Fig. 4.1c, adapted from the paper's Fig. 1c). FORM: CPMD rational CN, [1-(d/d0)^p]/[1-(d/d0)^(p+q)] (thesis eq. 4.1) = our r0=d0, n=p, m=p+q. PARAMETERS r0/n/m ARE PLACEHOLDERS — the original d0, p, q are unknown.

CV2.status: ATOMS CONFIRMED (secondary): CN of C2 with H1 and H2 — the SAME two hydrogens as CV1 (thesis Fig. 4.1c, adapted from the paper's Fig. 1c). Same CPMD rational form; PARAMETERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS (original d0, p, q unknown).

reference_basins.source: Approximate basin values as stated in Ali 2025 MSc thesis Sec. 4.2 (referring to Mushrif et al. 2015 Fig. 1c); not checked against the paper. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never a correctness test; not interpretable while CV1/CV2 parameters are unconfirmed. The data tips on the thesis's gas-phase FES plot (Fig. 7.3) put the minima at (1.04, 0.90) and (1.68, 0.25) instead — see README.
